user.title: Set up PV Battery Optimizer
user.description: Expand the sections below to configure all settings

data_description.strategy: Determines the objective used to calculate the recommended charge power

data.pv_remaining: PV Remaining Energy Today (multiple sensors allowed)

data_description.battery_soc: Sensor for the current battery state of charge in percent
data_description.house_power: Sensor for the current house power consumption in watts
data_description.nordpool: Sensor for the current electricity spot price in ct/kWh
data_description.power_limit: Entity for setting the maximum charge and discharge power (e.g. number.battery_max_charge_power)
data_description.pv_power: Sensor for the current total PV power in watts (sum sensor of all roof surfaces)
data_description.pv_remaining: Sensors for the remaining PV energy today in kWh – multiple sensors are summed
data_description.write_to_sensor: Enables automatic writing of the recommended charge power to the inverter entity (e.g. number.battery_max_charge_power) – default: disabled

data_description.min_soc: Lower charge limit in percent – never goes below this value
data_description.target_soc: Desired target state of charge in the evening

data.evening_target_hours: Hours Before Sunset for Evening Target

data_description.min_discharge_power: Minimum power in watts set at night and with little PV so the battery can supply the house (recommended: 3000 W)
data_description.evening_target_soc: State of charge in percent that the battery should reach at the start of the evening window (recommended: 85 %)
data_description.evening_target_hours: How many hours before sunset the evening target SOC should be reached (recommended: 2 h)
data_description.pv_day_factor: PV power must exceed house consumption by this factor before day mode activates (default 1.5 = 150 % of house consumption)
data_description.discharge_buffer_power: Buffer in watts above house consumption when PV drops below house consumption – prevents grid draw during brief cloud cover (default 500 W)
